name: teensyrom
description: Drive a TeensyROM cartridge in a Commodore 64 or 128: check its state, list and push files, launch them, reset, and read the screen

tr_host.title: TeensyROM address
tr_host.description: IP address or host name of a TeensyROM with its TCP listener on (host, or host:port). Leave empty to use USB serial.

tr_port.title: Serial port
tr_port.description: USB serial device of the TeensyROM, such as /dev/cu.usbmodem2101. Leave empty to use the first one found.
